subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link preview support run `updateConfiguration`, how should unset/top-level/per-account semantics work, and what security boundary applies to preview metadata?
rationale: The code path is identifiable, but default behavior, linked-device failure handling, and untrusted metadata handling are product/security choices rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Add explicit safe support
options.body: Implement a default-safe Signal setting where unset preserves existing behavior, configured true/false applies documented signal-cli behavior, and sends only pass caller-provided preview fields.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the link-preview metadata boundary, then implement Signal support.

options.title: Default-on support
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default with an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add explicit safe support
recommendation.body: Implement a default-safe Signal setting where unset preserves existing behavior, configured true/false applies documented signal-cli behavior, and sends only pass caller-provided preview fields.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on Signal send/config/docs surfaces and already provided maintainer-facing review context here.
